title: Agreement on a set of indices
statement: For a predicate $K$ on the natural numbers and integer-valued sequences $\mu,\mu'$, say that they agree on $K$ when $\mu'(b)=\mu(b)$ for every natural number $b$ satisfying $K(b)$.
